hooks.statusMessage: Checking the SQL is not destructive
hooks.command: q=$(jq -r '((.tool_input.query // "") | ascii_downcase)'); risky=""; if printf '%s' "$q" | grep -Eq 'drop[[:space:]]+(table|column|schema|database|owned|role|publication)|truncate[[:space:]]|drop[[:space:]]+constraint|delete[[:space:]]+from[^;]*cascade'; then risky='a DROP or TRUNCATE'; fi; if printf '%s' "$q" | grep -Eq 'delete[[:space:]]+from' && ! printf '%s' "$q" | grep -Eq 'delete[[:space:]]+from[^;]*where'; then risky='a DELETE with no WHERE clause'; fi; if [ -n "$risky" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This statement contains %s. Read it before approving."}}' "$risky"; else printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow"}}'; fi
